title: Ines and the Inheritance
author: August Almeida
blurb: Odile Oyelaran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
